findings.finding: The Rust std closure is still not covered by Q-L or Q-L2. (1) compiler_builtins, statically linked into every Rust binary, declares 'MIT AND Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception AND (MIT OR Apache-2.0)' (library/compiler-builtins/compiler-builtins/Cargo.toml:18 at b940084d). That is an AND compound, not an 'A OR B' expression, and the policy matches exact expressions. It already lists compound expressions such as 'Apache-2.0 AND LGPL-3.0-or-later' one by one. The check's EXPRESSION pattern cannot even record the parentheses: a probe adding it as a review was refused. (2) rustc-demangle 0.1.28, a std dependency (library/std/Cargo.toml:29), declares 'MIT/Apache-2.0', which is not a valid SPDX expression. (3) Other std dependencies are plain OR expressions the new rule covers, but each still needs its election recorded per component: hashbrown and cfg-if ('MIT OR Apache-2.0'), miniz_oxide ('MIT OR Zlib OR Apache-2.0'), adler2 ('0BSD OR MIT OR Apache-2.0'), object, libc. All of these are in every RUST_MUSL_STATIC module, yet LIC-RUST-STD names only std and core. They are also in runc, through libpathrs.a built against Debian's libstd-rust (runc Dockerfile:37-43). There, libpathrs' transitive crates `either` ('MIT OR Apache-2.0') and linux-raw-sys ('Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT') are missing from the D-LIC-CRATES-* subjects, which list direct dependencies only.

findings.finding: The TR-SETXID conclusion is right, but its reason is wrong. musl's setresuid and setresgid do go through __synccall (setxid.c:32), and __synccall signals threads with SYS_tkill (synccall.c:82). However, synccall.c:67 jumps to the single-threaded path when gettid() differs from self->tid. That is exactly the W4 child: a clone3 child without CLONE_VM, whose inherited self->tid belongs to the parent thread. So the child never issues tkill. The actual reasons the child must use raw syscalls are different. __synccall first takes __tl_lock (:59), which another broker thread may have held at clone time, so the child could deadlock. musl's state in the child is the parent's. And it adds rt_sigprocmask and gettid calls.
findings.requiredChange: Restate TR-SETXID's reason: the clone3 child may call only async-signal-safe raw syscalls, because of the inherited lock and libc state. Cite synccall.c:59 and :67.

Gaps in w03_plan.py: nothing checks that the selection's open items or LIC-RUST-STD are registered, so dropping SEL-SANDBOX or LIC-RUST-STD passes, although the README says every open item is registered.
